[P2] Compare earlier observations with the frozen capture

Both the retry-order loop and the side-effect progress check examine only `observation_evidence`; cleanup reconciliation excludes those earlier frames. One earlier snapshot reporting retry count 3 followed by frozen and retirement counts of 2 with `expectedCount=2` therefore produces no finding. Likewise, a single earlier retry order reversed relative to the frozen order escapes detection. Include the frozen frame after earlier observations when checking progress, and carry earlier retry-order constraints into reconciliation. Add regressions where one earlier frame contradicts only the frozen frame.
